title: Contract Testing API
description: Build a contract testing API that validates request and response shapes against a defined contract, checking for required fields and types.

steps.title: Return contract specification
steps.description: Create a GET /api/contract endpoint that returns a JSON contract defining the expected API shape.
hints: Define a contract with expectedBodyShape for each endpoint
Include properties and types for request/response

steps.title: Verify response shape matches contract
steps.description: Ensure the response from POST /items matches the expectedBodyShape defined in the contract.
hints: Create a POST /items endpoint that returns a response matching the contract shape
The response must have id (number) and name (string)

steps.title: POST with contract-matching body
steps.description: Send a POST request with a body that matches the contract schema and verify the response matches too.
hints: Send JSON with name field (string) as required by the contract
Expect 201 response with id and name fields
Verify the response has the expected shape

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class ItemIn(BaseModel):
    name: str

items = []
next_id = 1

@app.post('/items', status_code=201)
def create_item(item: ItemIn):
    global next_id
    new_item = {'id': next_id, 'name': item.name}
    next_id += 1
    items.append(new_item)
    return new_item

steps.title: POST with missing field returns 400
steps.description: Send a POST request with a missing required field and verify 400 error response.
hints: Send POST /items with an empty body or missing name field
Response should include an error message
